entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: A cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients with strict regional data residency, HIPAA, and EU MDR compliance.

entities.name: Patients (EU & US)
entities.description: Patients located in the EU and US seeking video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checking.

entities.name: Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Medical professionals providing remote video consultations and issuing e-prescriptions.

entities.name: Pharmacists (EU/US)
entities.description: Pharmacists fulfilling e-prescriptions across EU and US regions.

entities.name: Compliance & Regulatory Auditors
entities.description: Auditors reviewing system compliance against HIPAA and EU MDR regulations.

entities.name: National e-Prescription Gateways (EU)
entities.description: External national gateways in the EU for processing e-prescriptions using national standards.

entities.name: Pharmacy Systems (US)
entities.description: External US pharmacy systems for fulfilling prescriptions using HL7 FHIR.

entities.name: Third-Party Video Infrastructure (WebRTC CPaaS)
entities.description: CPaaS providing WebRTC-compatible video streaming services with adaptive bitrate codecs and TURN relays.

entities.name: Regional Identity Providers (eIDAS/OIDC/OAuth 2.0)
entities.description: External identity providers validating authentication tokens using eIDAS, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0.

entities.name: Regional API Gateways
entities.description: API gateways deployed in GCP regions to handle incoming regional traffic.

entities.name: Frontend UI (with localization)
entities.description: Localized user interface with offline-first local storage supporting compliance flows.

entities.name: AI Symptom Checker Service
entities.description: Provides AI-driven symptom checking with cryptographically signed outputs.

entities.name: Consent & Data Management Service
entities.description: Manages user consent and enforces regional data residency and CMEK encryption.

entities.name: Immutable Logging Service
entities.description: Records audit trails and cryptographically signed AI outputs locally per region.
entities.technology: GCP Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging, Pub/Sub

interfaces.description: Interact with the platform for consultations and symptom checking
Conduct video consultations and manage e-prescriptions
Review audit trails and compliance logs
Sends API requests for core telehealth operations
Manages encrypted patient data and regional consents
Streams cryptographically signed AI outputs for audit and traceability

naming_conventions: external systems use descriptive brackets for protocols or standards
containers reflect deployment regions or functional responsibilities
